ModMetaData.name: Sky Islands Minimap Fix
ModMetaData.author: JalapenoLabs
ModMetaData.description:
Fixes a crash where Dubs Mint Minimap throws a NullReferenceException on Sky Islands terrain.
Sky Islands terrain renders through custom graphics and leaves its texture path null. Dubs Mint Minimap's terrain color routine reads that path without a null check, so flying to a sky island blanked the minimap and threw an error every frame, which also stopped the needs and health tabs from drawing.
This adds a tiny Harmony guard so terrain with no texture path reads as a blank minimap tile instead of crashing. It changes nothing about how the terrain itself looks in the world. Applies only when Dubs Mint Minimap is installed; requires Harmony.
